sources.entry: Bugzilla - General-purpose bugtracker and testing tool originally developed and used by the Mozilla project. (Source Code) MPL-2.0 Perl

summary.one_liner: Bugzilla is a free, open source, web-based bug-tracking application developed by volunteers in the Mozilla community.
summary.what_it_does: Bugzilla is a web-based bug tracker that the README describes as general-purpose and used by many projects and companies. The README says it can be installed on Linux and other Unix flavors, Windows, or Mac OS X. Documentation with installation instructions is referenced but the link is not included in the README text. The README includes a Docker quick start: running "docker compose up" from the repository directory sets up an instance and prints the URL and default admin credentials to the console. It also notes that checksetup.pl may ask for interactive confirmation during UTF-8 conversion, which can be bypassed with the BZ_ALLOW_UNSAFE_UTF8_CONVERSION=1 environment variable. The README also lists developer IRC and mailing lists for development and support.
use_cases: manage defect reports for a development team
run a bug tracking instance in Docker for evaluation
how_to_run: cd into the bugzilla directory (containing the README)
Note the URL and default admin username and password shown on the console after setup finishes
If checksetup.pl stops for UTF-8 conversion confirmation, run: BZ_ALLOW_UNSAFE_UTF8_CONVERSION=1 docker compose up (only after understanding the warning and backing up data)
notable: Originally developed and used by the Mozilla project
Docker Compose quick start that prints admin credentials on setup
Runs on Linux, other Unix, Windows, and Mac OS X per the README
Mozilla Public License 2.0 with Incompatible With Secondary Licenses designation
caveats: Full installation instructions are in external documentation not reproduced in the README
Docker UTF-8 conversion may require interactive confirmation and an unsafe override flag with backups
The README says not to file test bugs in the installation used for real bug reports
